claim_verdicts.evidence: Attribution to Evans' Domain-Driven Design cannot be checked: no permitted documentation root covers the book. The lesson body never names Evans or the book, so no sentence depends on this claim.

Program.cs@stage-2:54-55 (git show): 'options.MapInboundClaims = false;' 'options.TokenValidationParameters.RoleClaimType = "roles";'. JwtBearerOptions.MapInboundClaims (aspnetcore-10.0): 'If this is set to true, the Claim Type is set to the JSON claim 'name' after translating using this mapping. Otherwise, no mapping occurs. The default value is true.' refs claims.md: 'ASP.NET Core adds default namespaces to some known claims.'

refs roles.md:13 'Roles are exposed to the developer through ClaimsPrincipal.IsInRole.' Program.cs@stage-2:64 RequireRole("staff"); OrderOwnerHandler.cs@stage-2:22 IsInRole("staff"). StaffOnly is used only at OrdersController.cs:91 and ProductsController.cs:63; customer endpoints use plain [Authorize]. "roles" is a string literal, so a claim rename leaves the build unaffected.

keycloak/donhang-realm.json@stage-2:48-57: protocolMapper 'oidc-usermodel-realm-role-mapper', 'claim.name': 'roles', 'access.token.claim': 'true', 'id.token.claim': 'false'. Program.cs@stage-2:53 comment 'the flat "roles" claim the realm adds'. The realm file is Keycloak configuration and references no Đơn Hàng class or table.
OrderOwnerHandler.cs@stage-2:28-29: 'var subject = context.User.FindFirstValue("sub");' 'var caller = subject is null ? null : await customers.FindByIdentitySubjectAsync(subject);'

NotificationSender.cs@stage-2:69 'var customer = notification.Order!.Customer!;', 70-71 read customer.Email and customer.FullName. Entities.cs@stage-2: Customer declares 'public required string FullName'. The claim now says NotificationSender.cs is 'among the files' that stop compiling, consistent with DonHangDbContext.cs:23 and EfOrderRepository.cs:28 also reading FullName (inspection; no build of a renamed copy was run).

Program.cs@stage-2:30-32: '// The host starts NotificationSender when the app starts ... it runs in this same process, beside the requests.' 'builder.Services.AddHostedService<NotificationSender>();'. NotificationSender : BackgroundService takes only IServiceScopeFactory and ILogger; no HTTP client.

JwtBearerOptions (aspnetcore-10.0) ConfigurationManager: 'Responsible for retrieving, caching, and refreshing the configuration from metadata.' AutomaticRefreshInterval: 'Gets or sets how often an automatic metadata refresh should occur.' RefreshOnIssuerKeyNotFound: refresh 'after a SecurityTokenSignatureKeyNotFoundException'. Cached metadata with periodic refresh means no Keycloak call per request.

refund-design.md@stage-2 step 4: 'Gửi lại sau lỗi mạng dùng đúng key đó, nên cổng không hoàn tiền lần hai (YC-9).' Step 6: 'Cổng xác nhận: ... dòng thành refunded'. Open questions: 'Nếu cổng không nhận idempotency key, bước 4 phải đổi thành hỏi trạng thái hoàn tiền trước mỗi lần gửi lại (R2 ...)'; 'Nếu cổng chỉ báo kết quả sau, bằng cách gọi ngược vào hệ thống, bước 6 phải đổi; ... (R1).'

STAGE.md@stage-2:76-78: '`stage-1` was one 3-layer API that signed its own tokens ... `stage-2` hands sign-in to Keycloak'; line 82 lists 'POST /api/v1/auth/login, AuthController, JwtTokenService' as removed. Program.cs@stage-1:39 builds its own IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(...).

Follows from the lesson's own definition of upstream (claim 1). Its factual parts check out: the API sends the metadata/key requests (claim 9); the gateway callback is the hypothetical named in refund-design.md's open questions (claim 10).
Design judgement, conditioned on the reuse decision and worded 'usual', not 'always'. The fact it leans on (stage-2 removed in-house sign-in) is verified under claim 11.

refund-design.md@stage-2 step 3: 'cùng cách với NotificationSender: hai giây một lần, nhận các dòng đến hạn bằng FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED'; step 5: 'thử lại sau 1 phút, rồi 2, 4, 8 phút, tối đa 1 giờ giữa hai lần, trong 24 giờ kể từ requested_at'. NotificationSender.cs@stage-2:17-19: '2 s after the first failure, then 4, 8, 16; the fifth failure is final.' MaxAttempts = 5.
Summary generalisation of three verified cases: run-time break for Keycloak (claim 4), compile-time break for notifications (claim 7), design-document change for the gateway (claim 10).

Entities.cs@stage-2: Order.Status takes new/paid/cancelled/shipped, Notification.Status pending/sent/failed, matching the glosses 'where an order is in its life' and 'whether one email has gone out'. NotificationSender reads no User/HttpContext/claims and is registered with AddHostedService, so no request starts it. The lesson now frames the three contexts as 'the reading from an earlier lesson', as outline item 5 of design.l3.contexts-inside-don-hang ('one reasonable reading') allows.
